decisions.reason: The generic complete-ordered-field and function-space suppliers do not identify the concrete real scalar field. Added thm-reals-ordered-field, which reaches def-real-numbers, thm-reals-field and def-real-order and supplies the ordered field used in F and the positive-scaling index set. The finite-list construction and quotient discharge remain sound; Definition unchanged. This is a nonfatal missing supplier declaration, repaired in item metadata.

SCHEMA explicitly permits a justified_by result to depend on its definition. Here the definition only introduces d^+ and d^- and the comparison notation. Lemma step 1.1 proves finite support and equal masses from total(d)=0 without assuming any signed-order property; step 1.2 proves unsigned cancellation, and steps 2.1 and 3.1 then derive the signed laws. There is no logical circularity or deps cycle.

Step 1.2 does not cancel C/r prematurely. For 0<=j<n, add j copies of B/r and n-j-1 copies of A/r to A/r+C/r<=B/r+C/r. This compares P_j to P_(j+1), with P_j=(n-j) copies of A/r plus j copies of B/r plus C/r. Transitivity yields P_0=A+C/r<=P_n=B+C/r, retaining exactly one shared C/r throughout. The supplied positive decreasing reciprocals then satisfy stability. Zero-mass C is zero; the pointwise-minimum decompositions also prove signed agreement, translation, transitivity and addition.

The supplied def-ordered-field uses positive-cone trichotomy: exactly one of x>0, x=0, -x>0. Assuming -1>0 and squaring gives 1>0 while -1>0 still holds, contradicting trichotomy at x=1. Hence 1>0 and -1 cannot be positive. If c>0 but c^(-1)<0, the product c*(-c^(-1))=-1 would be positive, a contradiction. Thus positive rescaling is licensed. The strict pair is distinct by reflexivity; all three signs of mu-lambda establish the claimed all-real equivalence.

The Verification Given already assumes distinct tags, so steps 1.1 and 2.1 are valid under their stated premises. However, the standalone Example setup X={a,b} did not impose distinctness and therefore permitted a=b, contradicting its unqualified strict-order assertion. Repaired this nonfatal public-setup omission by stating that a,b are distinct state tags in the Example. The proof, comparison rule and intended two-state model are unchanged.
